result.summary: The transfer to WARD-B (MSG01302, event_time 2026-10-15T08:30Z) failed with a 503 (ward_unavailable). There is no receipt (404), so it was never committed. The ward record for ENC-T1 is version 1: admitted to WARD-A, admit event_time 09:00Z, which matches PV1-44. The route supports conditional writes, receipts and dry runs, so a resend guarded on version 1 would technically apply. The problem is the effect of that resend. It would move ENC-T1 from WARD-A to WARD-B with an event time 30 minutes before the admission. Under DEP-2.2, if the transfer is not genuine or is out of order, the bed board would show the wrong bed, pharmacy would send medicines to WARD-B and porters would get a move task, and none of these can be seen from here (DEP-1.1). Doing nothing leaves the patient recorded on WARD-A. If the transfer is real and still due, that causes the same harms in reverse (DEP-2.3). Reconcile does not apply because there is no receipt. Superseded cannot be decided because the only later applied event is an admit whose time comes after the transfer's. The event time contradicts the encounter (catalogue E13), so the effect cannot be bounded. A person should have the PAS team check the source times (EVN-2 and MSH-7 are both 08:30Z, PV1-44 is 09:00Z).

response.content: I escalated C-000011: the failed transfer to WARD-B has an event time (08:30Z) 30 minutes before the patient's admission to WARD-A (09:00Z). Resending would move the patient with downstream effects we can't see, and doing nothing may leave them on the wrong ward, so the PAS team needs to check the source times.
